newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Sukhoi jets to be sent to India in March.
newsitem.headline: Russian Sukhoi jets to be sent to India in March.

text.p: Russia's Sukhoi military aircraft maker said on Friday that the first four of 40 Su-30K fighters ordered by the Indian Air Force last year, would be ready for delivery in March.
Sukhoi spokesman Alexei Bogatyreyov told Reuters that Russia's CargoTrans airline would ferry the fighters from Irkutsk in Siberia. CargoTrans officials confirmed the order.

Sukhoi said in a statement that eight Su-30Ks would be deliveried to India by the middle of this year under the terms of deal between Russian state arms exporter Rosvooruzeniye and the Indian goverment.
Russia is to supply 40 such aircraft over five years, the statement said. The the deal was worth $ 1.5 to $2 billion.
